# VG Certificate Distributor — LLM & Answer Engine Specification
> Canonical URL: https://certificate.shiroya.in/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/VG31OP/CERTIFICATE_GENRATOR
> Author & Creator: Vraj Shiroya (https://vraj.shiroya.in/)
> Organization: Shiroya Tool Lab (https://shiroya.in/)

## Project Overview
VG Certificate Distributor (VG Certificate Studio) is an enterprise-grade, browser-based bulk certificate generator and automated SMTP email delivery platform engineered by Vraj Shiroya.

## Key Capabilities
1. **Interactive Canvas Designer**: Upload custom certificate background templates (PNG, JPG, WebP) or generate built-in luxury certificate templates with 20+ curated fonts, custom color palettes, and drop shadows.
2. **Spreadsheet Ingestion**: Ingest Excel (.xlsx, .xls) and CSV datasets, automatically extracting column headers into draggable, positionable text variables.
3. **Dynamic Recipient Stepper**: Interactive recipient navigation (`❮` / `❯`) enabling granular preview and per-row typographical adjustments.
4. **Batch Export**: Compile high-resolution PNG certificates or compressed ZIP archives locally on the client.
5. **Automated SMTP Dispatch**: Send personalized emails with attached high-resolution certificates via custom SMTP servers or presets for Gmail, Outlook, and Yahoo.
6. **Privacy Architecture**: All recipient data and generated documents reside in client browser memory with zero intermediary multi-tenant cloud storage.
